episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: 2004. Frank Lampard, John Terry and Sir Alex Ferguson recall José Mourinho's bold arrival at Chelsea, where he becomes known as "The Special One."

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: 2007. Power struggles and tensions test the Chelsea manager as he eyes a new challenge in Serie A alongside Zlatan Ibrahimović and Luis Figo.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: 2010. Revenge and revolution collide when José Mourinho joins Real Madrid to end the dominance of the rival club he knows all too well…
